verdict.rationale: Kitty's first-party remote-control docs say scripts can open new windows and send arbitrary text to any window, and it advertises programmable tabs and splits. A recorded hands-on probe confirmed the full external control loop: `kitten @ ls` returned window and tab state as JSON, `send-text` ran a command in the live window, `get-text` read the output back, and `close-window` tore it down. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of creating a new pane/split via remote control (the probe launched kitty itself rather than a new split), and evidence documenting the underlying wire protocol beyond the CLI.
